lore: Forged where the End forgets its own edges. Four shards of scrap, four diamonds and the weight of Netherite were pressed into one bar, and it has been humming ever since.
Miners of the outer islands say it keeps a note only the void can hear.
use: Blast Raw Enderite Scrap into Enderite Scrap. Four scrap, four diamonds and a Netherite Ingot make one ingot; nine nuggets make one, too.
At a Smithing Table the Enderite Upgrade lifts Netherite gear and many blocks to Enderite. Enderite items are safe from the void; the armor lets you drift down while you hold jump.
secret: Hold an Enderite Nugget in your off hand and strike an Enchanting Table 20 times with a Netherite Sledgehammer: it becomes the Astral Enchanter, strong up to 50 with blazewood bookshelves and a Blazing Obsidian floor.
Break it, and table and nugget return. Eight nuggets around a bucket make the Enderite Bucket.

lore: No hand ever carved this block. It exists only while a chess piece stands on it, and vanishes with the last one.
use: The technical block that holds the chess pieces: up to four, one per quarter of the block top, each with its own facing. It has no item; placing a piece creates it, and breaking it drops the pieces.
secret: Lose the floor beneath it, or let a piston push it, and every piece drops at once. Nothing is lost, but the board is gone.

lore: A book bound with blaze powder instead of leather. It never quite cools down.
use: Three of them go into a blazewood bookshelf.
secret: Blazewood shelves reward the {item:simplebuilding:astral_enchanting_table}: each counts for two ordinary shelves there.

lore: Crying obsidian's glowing sibling: where the other weeps, this one burns.
use: A decorative block that gives light. Its job is at the Astral Enchanter: a 5 x 5 floor of it right under the table adds 10 strength once the shelves give 30.
secret: The floor only counts under the Astral Enchanter, not the vanilla table, so build it once the shelves are complete.

lore: The rope that holds a hammock up, seen by few and remembered by none.
use: The upper layer of a hammock: an invisible rope block in every cell the line between the anchors passes through. It has no item and no drops; the cloth head draws the whole hammock.
secret: A click on the rope lies you down just like a click on the cloth. If an anchor or any part goes, the whole hammock falls and drops once.

lore: A pink dust that drifts off the End's outer islands, still warm from the light it carries.
use: Dropped by Astralit Ore (Fortune adds more). Four dust in a square make a Block of Astralit. Also a trim material (Astralit), the heart of Astral Redstone, and the core of the Jukebox Amplifier.
secret: Recolor by dye: 8 End Stone around 1 dust make Astral End Stone. Dust plus Nihilit Shard plus quartz, shapeless, makes 2 Ender Quartz.

lore: A blue splinter of the void, cold like a held breath.
use: Dropped by Nihilit Ore (Fortune adds more). Four shards in a square make a Block of Nihilit. Also a trim material (Nihilit), the heart of Nihil Redstone, and the core of the Note Amplifier.
secret: Mixed with Astralit Dust and quartz it becomes Ender Quartz. As a trim, Nihilit lets you drop faster when you sneak in mid-air.

lore: A crystal of quartz with Astralit and Nihilit caught inside, like two moods in one stone.
use: Craft 1 Quartz, 1 Astralit Dust and 1 Nihilit Shard, shapeless, for 2. Four make a Block of Ender Quartz. It is the material of the purple End palette.
secret: It also recolors vanilla quartz: 8 quartz blocks around 1 Ender Quartz make 8 Ender Quartz blocks of the same shape.

lore: It waits on the very top of the End's islands, and glints at anyone with a good pickaxe.
use: Generates in end stone on the surface of the outer islands. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better, hardness 20, drops Astralit Dust and 3 to 7 experience. Fortune raises the drop, Silk Touch keeps the ore.
secret: It glows with light level 5, so you can spot a vein from far away at night. Its twin, Nihilit Ore, hides on the underside of the islands.

lore: It hangs under the End's islands like a bruise in the dark.
use: Generates in end stone on the underside of the islands. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better, hardness 25, drops a Nihilit Shard and 3 to 7 experience. Fortune raises the drop, Silk Touch keeps the ore.
secret: Look down, not up: it forms only where end stone has air below it, and it does not glow, unlike Astralit Ore on the top.

lore: Redstone that has learned a second language, and speaks it only to its own kind.
use: Astralit Dust plus redstone, shapeless, make 2. It carries only the Astralit channel, on horizontal neighbors of the same kind, on a sturdy top face. A switch or lamp of the same channel reads it; vanilla redstone is ignored.
secret: Signals decay when you remove the source, and closed loops keep no power. Lamps only receive and never relay. The same dust crafts its rails and its piston.

lore: Redstone from the other side of the void, quiet and cold.
use: Nihilit Shard plus redstone, shapeless, make 2. It carries only the Nihilit channel, on horizontal neighbors of the same kind, on a sturdy top face. A switch or lamp of the same channel reads it; vanilla redstone is ignored.
secret: Each segment updates every two game ticks, and a switch powers at most 15 segments by default. The same shard crafts the Nihil Rail and the Nihil Piston.

lore: A rail that has heard the sky and wants to go there.
use: Six gold ingots, a stick and Astral Redstone make 6. Straight only. Powered by its own channel, it pushes carts to a top speed of 16 blocks per second by default (vanilla 8). Unpowered it is a plain rail.
secret: The boost fades the closer a cart gets to top speed, so it approaches the limit and never reaches it. On slopes and in water the vanilla limit applies, so brake before a curve.

lore: A rail that takes the speed out of the world, politely and completely.
use: Six gold ingots, a stick and Nihil Redstone make 6. Straight only. Powered by its own channel, it brakes: each tick the cart keeps 80 percent of its speed minus a small amount, stops, and is held while power stays on.
secret: Unpowered it lets carts roll through. Only its own channel powers it, not vanilla redstone or neighboring rails, so you can build a station that brakes on a signal.

lore: An ender chest that learned to keep more, and keeps it just for you.
use: Craft an ender chest with six Enderite Nuggets and two Astralit Dust. It opens 54 personal slots: the first 27 are your vanilla ender inventory, the other 27 belong to you alone.
secret: The extra slots live in your ender inventory data and survive respawn. Breaking the vault drops the vault, not the contents; hoppers cannot reach them. A solid block on top blocks opening.

lore: A chest at the edge of every world, and every world is its edge.
use: Craft an ender chest with six Enderite Nuggets and two Nihilit Shards. All Nihil Vaults in all dimensions share one 54-slot container; every player who opens any of them sees and changes the same items.
secret: Break a vault and the shared contents stay, ready in every other or newly placed vault. Open menus stay in sync like players at one chest, so nothing duplicates. Hoppers and comparators get nothing.

lore: A table where the stars hold still while you choose.
use: Pick your enchantments yourself: three random ones that fit the item, each with a slider from 0 to its maximum, paid from a level budget that the bookshelves around it set.
secret: Hit an enchanting table 20 times with a Netherite Sledgehammer while holding an Enderite Nugget in your off hand: it becomes this. Blazewood shelves count double, a Blazing Obsidian floor adds strength. Break it and table and nugget return.

lore: End stone with its rough edges taken off, ready to be dressed in color.
use: Craft 4 End Stone Bricks in a square for 4, or cut it from end stone or end stone bricks in the stonecutter. It is the raw material of Astral and Nihil End Stone.
secret: Put 8 around one Astralit Dust or Nihilit Shard and they take its color: that is how the coated end stones are made.

lore: {name}: Stone ground into a head and bound to a handle: slow to lift, simple to love.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 760 durability, enchantability 5. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: Made from an iron ingot, two cobblestone and two sticks. It mines like a stone pickaxe, but takes a whole 3x3 face of identical blocks per swing.

lore: {name}: Copper takes a dent and keeps the shape, like a good argument.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 760 durability, enchantability 13. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: A copper block, two copper ingots and two sticks. Sneak and hold right-click to carve the aimed eighth off a block; stairs and slabs are what remains.

lore: {name}: Iron makes a head that has never once been talked out of anything.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 1000 durability, enchantability 14. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: The Toolsmith sells iron and diamond sledgehammers at level 4, each with one enchantment out of Break Through, Override, Range, Unbreaking or Efficiency.

lore: {name}: Gold hits as hard as anyone, and breaks as soon as anyone looks at it sideways.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 128 durability, enchantability 22. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: It has the best enchantability of the line (22) and the fewest uses (128). Gold sledgehammers lie in bastions.

lore: {name}: A head of diamond: it does not hit things, it settles arguments.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 6244 durability, enchantability 10. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: Hold right-click on a diamond block to crush it into 81 Diamond Pebbles. At this tier a hammer can raise chests from Reinforced to Netherite (with a nugget) and forge the Netherite Piston.

lore: {name}: Netherite swings like a decision that was already made.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 8124 durability, enchantability 15. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: With an Enderite Nugget in the off hand it lifts machines and chests to Enderite. Hit an enchanting table 20 times with it, holding an Enderite Nugget in the other hand, and it becomes the Astral Enchanter.

lore: {name}: It weighs what the End weighs: nothing, until it lands.
use: The heavy pickaxe: one swing mines a whole 3x3 plane of the same block instead of one. 10000 durability, enchantability 18. Sneak while mining takes only the aimed block.
secret: Fire resistant, floats on lava, and cannot be lost in the void: dropped Enderite items hang in place and lie twice as long as vanilla allows.

lore: {name}: The first tool of every builder: shaped from a stick, a cobblestone and two copper nuggets.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 192 durability, base cooldown 30 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: Right-click turns stone into chiseled stone bricks or smooth sandstone into cut sandstone. Sneak and right-click walks the chain back for 2 durability.

lore: {name}: A copper tip that remembers the shape of everything it touched.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 192 durability, base cooldown 25 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: The Toolsmith sells copper, iron and gold chisels with Fast Chiseling for 6 emeralds from level 3. Copper and iron work on stone bricks, polished stone, tuff and planks.

lore: {name}: Iron sets the edge, the hand sets the line.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 256 durability, base cooldown 25 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: The Toolsmith sells it with Fast Chiseling for 6 emeralds from level 3. Upgrade a copper chisel with the Basic Upgrade and 2 ingots, keeping its damage, name and enchantments.

lore: {name}: A gold chisel is more jewel than tool, and cuts quartz as if it were butter.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 128 durability, base cooldown 20 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: Gold and diamond chisels handle quartz, tuff bricks, blackstone, basalt and deepslate. Gold chisels lie in buried treasure; the Toolsmith sells them with Fast Chiseling.

lore: {name}: The edge of a diamond finds the seam in any stone.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 392 durability, base cooldown 10 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: Diamond chisels lie in buried treasure and in igloo chests. It carries quartz, tuff bricks, blackstone, basalt and deepslate chains, and starts the climb to Netherite.

lore: {name}: A chisel that has stood in fire and learned patience.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 512 durability, base cooldown 5 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: It adds the nether brick cycle, resin bricks and chiseled sandstone back to sand to its chains. Fire resistant, with the shortest cooldown, 5 ticks.

lore: {name}: It cuts stone that was never quarried, only imagined.
use: A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain of related variants; sneaking walks the chain back. 600 durability, base cooldown 5 ticks. Fast Chiseling shortens it.
secret: The only chisel for the End palettes: polished, pillar, bricks, chiseled, then the block itself, and on through the veined, crystalline and layered or frosted patterns. Sneak walks it back.

lore: {name}: The first wand: a copper core, two sticks, and a reach of three blocks.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 3x3. 1520 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: The Mason sells the finished wand at level 4 for 62 emeralds. Copper Cores come from the Wandering Trader for 24 emeralds.

lore: {name}: Iron stretches the wand to a 5x5 area.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 5x5. 2000 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: An Iron Building Wand sometimes lies in woodland mansions. Upgrade a copper wand at the smithing table with the Basic Upgrade and an iron core.

lore: {name}: Gold pays for its 7x7 reach with a short life.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 7x7. 256 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: Upgrade an iron wand with the Basic Upgrade and a gold core. Gold wands are the shortest-lived of the line.

lore: {name}: A diamond wand fills a 9x9 face in one move.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 9x9. 12488 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: A Diamond Building Wand can be found in end cities. Upgrading from gold takes the Basic Upgrade and a diamond core.

lore: {name}: Netherite fills 11x11 and never flinches.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 11x11. 16248 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: Smithing table: Netherite Upgrade, a Diamond Building Wand and a Netherite Ingot. Fire resistant like all netherite gear.

lore: {name}: The widest wand a survival builder can hold: 13x13 in a single click.
use: Right-click a block face to fill a square area with blocks from your inventory, up to 13x13. 20000 durability. The tier of the core sets how large the area can get.
secret: Smithing table: Enderite Upgrade, a Netherite Building Wand and an Enderite Ingot. Constructor's Touch unlocks the wand menu; a Blueprint in the other hand builds whole structures.

lore: A wand with no limits, handed out by no one in survival.
use: Creative tab only: fills up to 13x13, with unlimited reach (up to 1024 blocks), no durability and no material use.
secret: Hold a Creative Blueprint in the off hand and it builds at any distance; a signed blueprint is final.

lore: A blueprint that costs nothing and is worth the world.
use: A Blueprint only in the creative tab, with no recipe. A building wand with it in the off hand builds the structure at any distance.
secret: Once signed it is final. Use it for creative builds you want to place from afar.

lore: A sheet that remembers a house before it exists.
use: Holds a structure as readable build code: write it in the editor, fill it by scanning an Octant selection at a cartography table, and build it with a building wand held in the other hand.
secret: Sneak and right-click lays it down flat on the floor, on a wall or under a ceiling, as a placed blueprint. The wand then reads it from there.

lore: A blueprint laid out like a map on a table, waiting for its builder.
use: A blueprint laid down with sneak and right-click: flat on the floor, on a wall or under the ceiling. It has no item of its own; it holds the blueprint itself.
secret: Break it and you get the blueprint back with everything written in it.

lore: {name}: A nether star set in copper, the humblest star a builder can own.
use: Craft: a nether star surrounded by four copper ingots in a plus. Part of the Copper Building Wand and the Velocity Gauge. The Wandering Trader sells it for 24 emeralds.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 10000, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: {name}: A star in iron: dull on the outside, bright where it matters.
use: Craft: a nether star surrounded by four iron ingots in a plus. Part of the Iron Building Wand, Resonance Rod, Attractor and Rotator. The Wandering Trader sometimes sells it for 32 emeralds.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 7000, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: {name}: A star in gold, vain enough to enjoy being looked at.
use: Craft: a nether star surrounded by four gold ingots in a plus. Part of the Gold Building Wand, the Detector and the Octant. The Wandering Trader sometimes sells it for 48 emeralds.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 5000, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: {name}: A star in diamond: the light inside it has been counted and found sufficient.
use: Craft: a nether star surrounded by four diamonds in a plus. Part of the Diamond Building Wand and the base of the Netherite Core. The Wandering Trader sometimes sells it for 64 emeralds.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 3500, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: {name}: A star in netherite, dark on the outside, loud on the inside.
use: Forged from a Diamond Core and a Netherite Ingot with the Netherite Upgrade at the smithing table. Part of the Netherite Building Wand. Fire resistant. Stack size 1.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 2500, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: {name}: A star in enderite. It does not shine; it listens.
use: Forged from a Netherite Core and an Enderite Ingot with the Enderite Upgrade at the smithing table. Part of the Enderite Building Wand and the Echo Sounder. Fire resistant. Stack size 1.
secret: Easter egg: right-click stone, deepslate, tuff, netherrack, end stone and the like with it, and there is a tiny chance, 1 in 2000, that the block turns into an ore. The core is not used up.

lore: A rod of iron, thin, straight, and eager to be struck by something.
use: Three iron ingots stacked give one iron rod, a lightning rod of iron. Part of the Attractor recipe.
secret: The Attractor is built around an iron core, an iron rod, redstone and lapis.

lore: A rod of gold: too soft for work, too shining to hide.
use: Three gold ingots stacked give one gold rod, a lightning rod of gold.
secret: Rods in this mod come in tiers: iron and gold from ingots, diamond from diamonds, then Netherite and Enderite from the smithing table.

lore: A rod of diamond, as hard as an argument and as clear as a lie.
use: Three diamonds stacked give one diamond rod; one diamond rod in the crafting grid gives the diamonds back. It cannot be placed. At the smithing table it becomes the Netherite Rod.
secret: At the fletching table it is an arrow shaft: the arrow pierces one more target.

lore: A rod that has stood in the fire and does not mind the next one.
use: Smithing table: Netherite Upgrade, Diamond Rod and Netherite Ingot give the Netherite Rod, a lightning rod made of netherite.
secret: It is the base for the Enderite Rod, one tier up.

lore: A rod that remembers the sky and draws lightning like a promise.
use: Smithing table: Enderite Upgrade, Netherite Rod and Enderite Ingot give the Enderite Rod, a lightning rod made of enderite.
secret: Being enderite, it is fire resistant, floats on lava and is safe from the void if it is dropped.

lore: A rod put upright, the smallest monument.
use: A stick, bone, blaze rod, breeze rod or diamond rod standing upright: sneak and right-click the top of a block. It is a thin column of the item's own pixels, and it drops the rod itself.
secret: Breaking it drops the rod itself, so nothing is lost. A goat horn holder can carry a rod as well.

lore: A goat horn put down as a holder, still carrying its call.
use: Sneak and right-click with a goat horn on the top of a block (mouth up) or on a wall (hanging from a peg). It holds a torch or a rod. Not under a ceiling.
secret: The horn keeps its sound and name, and drops again when you break the holder.

lore: A tiny piece of the End's heaviest metal, small enough to hide.
use: Nine nuggets make an Enderite Ingot, and the ingot gives nine back. Eight around an iron bucket make the Enderite Bucket. Enderite Apples, Carrots and machine upgrades use it.
secret: Hammer an Astral Enchanter into being with one in your off hand; it returns when you break the table. A nugget in the off hand also pays for lifting chests and machines to Enderite.

lore: A nugget of ancient debris, forged and still warm.
use: Nine nuggets make a Netherite Ingot and the ingot gives nine back. Netherite Apples and Carrots use it, and so do machine upgrades.
secret: Hold one in the off hand and hammer a Reinforced chest or machine with a Diamond Sledgehammer to lift it to Netherite.

lore: A fragment of the End's own ore, still rough from the dark.
use: Craft an Ender Pearl, Astralit Dust and a Nihilit Shard, shapeless. It is the first step toward Enderite.
secret: One fragment becomes Raw Enderite Scrap, which a furnace melts into Enderite Scrap.

lore: Raw Enderite, pressed in layers, ready for the fire.
use: Craft one Raw Enderite Fragment shapeless to get it. A blast furnace melts it into Enderite Scrap.
secret: Blast it into Enderite Scrap; four scrap, four diamonds and a Netherite Ingot then make an Enderite Ingot.

lore: What is left when the End's raw ore meets a furnace and loses its illusions.
use: Smelted from Raw Enderite Scrap. Four scrap, four diamonds and one Netherite Ingot craft an Enderite Ingot.
secret: Fire resistant and floating on lava, like all Enderite from the ingot upward. Dropped scrap lies for 10 minutes before it despawns.

lore: Nine ingots of the End, folded into a cube: the heaviest thing a builder can own.
use: Nine Enderite Ingots in a 3x3 square make a Block of Enderite. It is a storage and decoration block.
secret: It is part of the enderite item family, so it is safe from the void if it ever drops as an item.

lore: A template stamped with the End's own seal.
use: Smithing template: with a netherite piece and an Enderite Ingot it makes the Enderite version of tools, armor, spears and containers. Craft: 7 diamonds around an end stone and the template for 2.
secret: One template, 7 diamonds and an end stone yield 2 templates: you never need to hunt for more. It can also be placed in the world with sneak and right-click.

lore: A modest template for modest upgrades, which are the ones everybody needs.
use: Smithing table: raises copper tools to iron, iron to gold, gold to diamond, and vanilla wood to stone to iron. It costs twice the crafting material. Duplicate: one template, 7 diamonds and an iron block make 2.
secret: Name, damage and enchantments carry over, and so does a Building Wand's core upgrade: you only add a core of the new tier.

lore: A trim that holds the light a moment longer than it should.
use: Craft 4 diamonds, 2 glowstone blocks and a template, or upgrade a placed armor trim template with sledgehammer hits while a Glow Ink Sac or Glowstone Dust sits in the off hand. One template, 7 diamonds and a glowstone block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, template, armor and a Glow Ink Sac make the trim glow steadily at full brightness. It only glows visually and gives off no real light.

lore: A trim that does not just shine, it lights the way for others.
use: Upgrade a placed armor trim template with sledgehammer hits while a Glow Ink Sac or Glowstone Dust is in the off hand; it consumes 2 blaze powder and 4 diamonds. One template, 7 diamonds and a magma block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, with Glowstone Dust, armor becomes a wearable light source: an invisible light block follows your head. More dust raises the radiance, up to level 5.

lore: A trim with a heartbeat of its own.
use: Craft 2 echo shards, 2 sculk, 4 diamonds and any sledgehammer; the hammer stays in the grid and loses 1 durability. One template, 7 diamonds and a sculk block make 2.
secret: At the smithing table, template, armor and an Echo Shard make the trim pulse from full color to gray every 2.4 seconds. Together with Glowing, the brightness pulses too.

lore: {name}: The first step above the copper chest.
use: 36 slots, 72 as a double chest.
secret: Craft: 3 copper chests of any oxidation, waxed or not, plus 6 Cracked Diamonds make 3. Or hold right-click for 5 seconds on a placed copper chest with any sledgehammer and a Cracked Diamond in the off hand; the contents stay.

lore: {name}: a chest with a held breath.
use: Trapped version of the chest of its tier: 36 slots, 72 in a double chest, and it signals its viewer count like the vanilla trapped chest.
secret: Craft it shapeless from the chest of the tier and one tripwire hook. Only two trapped chests of the same tier join into a double; normal chests and other tiers stay separate.

lore: {name}: a boat that has stopped being afraid of its cargo.
use: The chest boat of the Reinforced tier, in every wood (bamboo: raft). 36 slots, the same as the chest.
secret: Craft a boat (or raft) of any wood with the chest of the tier, shapeless; the wood stays on the item. Sneak and right-click opens the chest menu. Smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a chest that finally got its rails.
use: The chest minecart of the tier: 36 slots, the same as the chest of the tier.
secret: Craft a minecart with the chest of the tier, shapeless. Hoppers and hopper minecarts fill and empty it like the vanilla chest minecart; smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a box that has learned to keep more than it shows.
use: 36 slots. Craft any vanilla shulker box with 4 Cracked Diamonds, shapeless, or hold right-click on a placed one for 10 blows with any sledgehammer and 2 Cracked Diamonds in the off hand.
secret: Contents, name, lock, facing and color stay through the upgrade. Oversized stacks leave the box one normal stack at a time.

lore: {name}: a shell that grew another layer while no one watched.
use: The shell of the shulker box tier. Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Shulkers of end cities drop 0 to 2 of their own shell.
secret: Every tier also comes from the shell one tier below in the world. Craft any copper chest, a tier shell and a vanilla Shulker Shell to get the tier's shulker box.

lore: {name}: Netherite makes the chest hold twice as much per slot.
use: 45 slots, 90 as a double chest. Each slot holds 2x the normal stack size (unstackable items stay at 1).
secret: Hold right-click for 5 seconds on a placed Reinforced Chest, with a Netherite Nugget in the off hand and a Diamond Sledgehammer or better. The chest keeps its items, name and lock. Double chests only form from equal tiers.

lore: {name}: a chest with a held breath.
use: Trapped version of the chest of its tier: 45 slots, 90 in a double chest, and it signals its viewer count like the vanilla trapped chest. Each slot holds 2x the normal stack size (unstackable items stay at 1).
secret: Craft it shapeless from the chest of the tier and one tripwire hook. Only two trapped chests of the same tier join into a double; normal chests and other tiers stay separate.

lore: {name}: a boat that has stopped being afraid of its cargo.
use: The chest boat of the Netherite tier, in every wood (bamboo: raft). 45 slots with 2x stacks, the same as the chest.
secret: Craft a boat (or raft) of any wood with the chest of the tier, shapeless; the wood stays on the item. Sneak and right-click opens the chest menu. Smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a chest that finally got its rails.
use: The chest minecart of the tier: 45 slots with 2x stacks, the same as the chest of the tier.
secret: Craft a minecart with the chest of the tier, shapeless. Hoppers and hopper minecarts fill and empty it like the vanilla chest minecart; smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a box that has learned to keep more than it shows.
use: 45 slots, each with 2x the normal stack size. No recipe: a placed Reinforced one becomes this after 10 blows with a Diamond Sledgehammer or better and 2 Netherite Nuggets in the off hand.
secret: Contents, name, lock, facing and color stay through the upgrade. Oversized stacks leave the box one normal stack at a time.

lore: {name}: a shell that grew another layer while no one watched.
use: The shell of the shulker box tier. Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Shulkers of end cities drop 0 to 2 of their own shell.
secret: Every tier also comes from the shell one tier below in the world. Craft any copper chest, a tier shell and a vanilla Shulker Shell to get the tier's shulker box.

lore: {name}: The End makes a chest as big as a double chest, with fourfold stacks.
use: 54 slots, 108 as a double chest. Each slot holds 4x the normal stack size (unstackable items stay at 1).
secret: Hold right-click for 5 seconds on a placed Netherite Chest, with an Enderite Nugget in the off hand and a Netherite Sledgehammer. The chest keeps everything inside. Void-proof and fire resistant as an item.

lore: {name}: a chest with a held breath.
use: Trapped version of the chest of its tier: 54 slots, 108 in a double chest, and it signals its viewer count like the vanilla trapped chest. Each slot holds 4x the normal stack size (unstackable items stay at 1).
secret: Craft it shapeless from the chest of the tier and one tripwire hook. Only two trapped chests of the same tier join into a double; normal chests and other tiers stay separate.

lore: {name}: a boat that has stopped being afraid of its cargo.
use: The chest boat of the Enderite tier, in every wood (bamboo: raft). 54 slots with 4x stacks, the same as the chest.
secret: Craft a boat (or raft) of any wood with the chest of the tier, shapeless; the wood stays on the item. Sneak and right-click opens the chest menu. Smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a chest that finally got its rails.
use: The chest minecart of the tier: 54 slots with 4x stacks, the same as the chest of the tier.
secret: Craft a minecart with the chest of the tier, shapeless. Hoppers and hopper minecarts fill and empty it like the vanilla chest minecart; smithing lifts it a tier.

lore: {name}: a box that has learned to keep more than it shows.
use: 54 slots, each with 4x the normal stack size. No recipe: a placed Netherite one becomes this after 10 blows with a Netherite Sledgehammer or better and 2 Enderite Nuggets in the off hand.
secret: Contents, name, lock, facing and color stay through the upgrade. Oversized stacks leave the box one normal stack at a time.

lore: {name}: a shell that grew another layer while no one watched.
use: The shell of the shulker box tier. Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Shulkers of end cities drop 0 to 2 of their own shell.
secret: Every tier also comes from the shell one tier below in the world. Craft any copper chest, a tier shell and a vanilla Shulker Shell to get the tier's shulker box.

lore: {name}: Leather sheet, string, a heavy weighted pressure plate and copper nuggets: every adventure starts with a bag.
use: Wearable storage with 9 slots; grants 1 armor worn in the chest slot. Right-click puts it on; press B (backpack key) to open it. Craft: copper nuggets, string, heavy weighted pressure plates and leather sheets.
secret: It only opens while worn, so a chestplate or elytra and a backpack exclude each other. The contents are stored on the item itself, so they travel with it, even when dropped on death.

lore: {name}: A bag with diamond stitching, built to carry the weight of a long day.
use: Wearable storage with 18 slots; grants 2 armor worn in the chest slot. Right-click puts it on; press B (backpack key) to open it. Upgrade a backpack in the crafting table with four diamond pebbles; the contents stay.
secret: It only opens while worn, so a chestplate or elytra and a backpack exclude each other. The contents are stored on the item itself, so they travel with it, even when dropped on death.

lore: {name}: A bag that has been through fire and keeps its contents anyway.
use: Wearable storage with 33 slots; grants 3 armor worn in the chest slot. Right-click puts it on; press B (backpack key) to open it. Smithing table upgrade of the Reinforced Backpack. It survives explosions as a dropped item.
secret: It only opens while worn, so a chestplate or elytra and a backpack exclude each other. The contents are stored on the item itself, so they travel with it, even when dropped on death.

lore: {name}: The End has room for anything, and so does this bag.
use: Wearable storage with 50 slots; grants 4 armor worn in the chest slot. Right-click puts it on; press B (backpack key) to open it. Smithing table upgrade of the Netherite Backpack. It survives explosions and is safe from the void.
secret: It only opens while worn, so a chestplate or elytra and a backpack exclude each other. The contents are stored on the item itself, so they travel with it, even when dropped on death.

lore: A bundle that took a leather sheet and diamond pebbles to learn how to hold more.
use: 1.5x the capacity of a vanilla bundle, 96 items at stack size 64. Craft: string above a bundle, a leather sheet below, six diamond pebbles in the side columns. The bundle's contents, enchantments and name carry over.
secret: The mouse wheel in the inventory picks which entry it hands back. It is the base for the bundle enchantments Deep Pockets, Funnel, Drawer, Master Builder and Color Palette. Sneak and right-click sets it down as a 3D bundle.

lore: A bundle that is not afraid of fire, nor of what it carries.
use: The smithing table upgrade of the Reinforced Bundle: double the base capacity, fire resistant, and it survives explosions as a dropped item.
secret: Like the other tiers it takes the bundle enchantments at an anvil. The Enderite Bundle is its next step.

lore: A bundle with the whole End folded into the cloth.
use: The top bundle tier: triple the base capacity, fire resistant, safe from explosions and from the void as a dropped item, and it takes the bundle enchantments at an anvil.
secret: Dropped in the void it hangs in place and waits 10 minutes before it despawns, twice the usual time.

lore: A bundle set down on a table, as if someone meant to come back.
use: A bundle set down with sneak and right-click on the top of a block, drawn as a 3D bundle. It has no item of its own; it holds the bundle and its contents.
secret: Break it and the whole bundle returns, filled as you left it.

lore: A bundle that only wants arrows, and has never once been disappointed.
use: Takes only arrows, both when clicked in and when picked up off the ground, and feeds a bow automatically from the off hand, the chest slot or the hotbar. Craft: string, leather, a copper nugget and a bundle.
secret: Arrows, spectral arrows and tipped arrows go in; a bow does not. Upgrade it at the crafting table into the Reinforced Quiver and it keeps its arrows.

lore: A quiver with leather sheet and pebbles of diamond in its seams.
use: Capacity factor 3/2, 96 arrows. Crafted from a Quiver at the crafting table without losing its arrows. It is the only item the Netherite Quiver can be smithed from.
secret: Enchantments and name carry over when it is upgraded. At the smithing table it becomes the Netherite Quiver.

lore: A quiver that has met fire and been improved by it.
use: The smithing table upgrade of the Reinforced Quiver, capacity factor 2, fire resistant, rarity uncommon.
secret: It survives explosions as a dropped item. Only arrows go in.

lore: A quiver with an end that does not come.
use: The top quiver tier, smithed from the Netherite Quiver: capacity factor 3, fire resistant, epic. As a dropped item it is immune to explosions and safe from the void.
secret: It takes the mod's enchantments at an anvil like the lower tiers.

lore: {name}: Three dyes over three planks: a palette in a box.
use: Keeps dyes like a bundle: only dyes, up to 64 of each of the 16 colors. Craft from a red, a yellow and a blue dye over three planks. Left-click puts dyes in, right-click with an empty cursor takes a stack out.
secret: It feeds the Color Brush: each stroke paints with a random color other than the block's, and the brush shows rainbow bristles. The mouse wheel over the box chooses which color comes out.

lore: {name}: The same colors, in a stronger box.
use: Keeps dyes like a bundle: only dyes, up to 128 of each of the 16 colors. Crafting table: the box in the middle, four diamond pebbles beside it, four gold nuggets in the corners; it keeps its dyes. Left-click puts dyes in, right-click with an empty cursor takes a stack out.
secret: It feeds the Color Brush: each stroke paints with a random color other than the block's, and the brush shows rainbow bristles. The mouse wheel over the box chooses which color comes out.

lore: {name}: A paint box that has stood in the fire and kept its colors.
use: Keeps dyes like a bundle: only dyes, up to 256 of each of the 16 colors. Smithing table: Netherite Upgrade and a netherite ingot. Left-click puts dyes in, right-click with an empty cursor takes a stack out.
secret: It feeds the Color Brush: each stroke paints with a random color other than the block's, and the brush shows rainbow bristles. The mouse wheel over the box chooses which color comes out.

lore: {name}: It holds more colors than the world has names for.
use: Keeps dyes like a bundle: only dyes, up to 512 of each of the 16 colors. Smithing table: Enderite Upgrade and an Enderite Ingot. Left-click puts dyes in, right-click with an empty cursor takes a stack out.
secret: It feeds the Color Brush: each stroke paints with a random color other than the block's, and the brush shows rainbow bristles. The mouse wheel over the box chooses which color comes out.

lore: {name}: The first step: a furnace with a bit of ambition.
use: Runs 2 times as fast as the vanilla furnace for smelting, with the same recipes and menu. Craft: 3 Cracked Diamonds, 3 appliances, 3 Cracked Diamonds in the crafting table.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

lore: {name}: The first step: a furnace with a bit of ambition.
use: Runs 2 times as fast as the vanilla blast furnace for ores and metal, with the same recipes and menu. Burns fuel twice as long as the vanilla one. Craft: 3 Cracked Diamonds, 3 appliances, 3 Cracked Diamonds in the crafting table.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

lore: {name}: The first step: a furnace with a bit of ambition.
use: Runs 2 times as fast as the vanilla smoker for food, with the same recipes and menu. Burns fuel twice as long as the vanilla one. Craft: 3 Cracked Diamonds, 3 appliances, 3 Cracked Diamonds in the crafting table.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

lore: {name}: a furnace that decided to travel.
use: One fuel item burns 2 times as long as in the vanilla furnace minecart, and the cart runs faster the higher the tier.
secret: Craft a minecart with the furnace of the same tier, shapeless; smithing lifts it a tier. Right-click pushes the cart away from you. The Enderite one reaches the full top speed of a plain minecart.

lore: {name}: It cooks like a forge that has forgotten how to cool.
use: Runs 4 times as fast as the vanilla furnace for smelting, with the same recipes and menu. No recipe: hammer a placed Reinforced one with a Diamond Sledgehammer or better and a Netherite Nugget.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

lore: {name}: It cooks like a forge that has forgotten how to cool.
use: Runs 4 times as fast as the vanilla blast furnace for ores and metal, with the same recipes and menu. Burns fuel twice as long as the vanilla one. No recipe: hammer a placed Reinforced one with a Diamond Sledgehammer or better and a Netherite Nugget.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

secret: Craft a minecart with the furnace of the same tier, shapeless; smithing lifts it a tier. Right-click pushes the cart away from you. The Enderite one reaches the full top speed of a plain minecart.

lore: {name}: The fastest fire in the game, tamed in a box.
use: Runs 8 times as fast as the vanilla furnace for smelting, with the same recipes and menu. Double experience. No recipe: hammer a placed Netherite one with a Netherite Sledgehammer and an Enderite Nugget.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

lore: {name}: The fastest fire in the game, tamed in a box.
use: Runs 8 times as fast as the vanilla blast furnace for ores and metal, with the same recipes and menu. Double experience. Burns fuel twice as long as the vanilla one. No recipe: hammer a placed Netherite one with a Netherite Sledgehammer and an Enderite Nugget.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.

use: Runs 8 times as fast as the vanilla smoker for food, with the same recipes and menu. Double experience. Burns fuel twice as long as the vanilla one. No recipe: hammer a placed Netherite one with a Netherite Sledgehammer and an Enderite Nugget.
secret: The speed-up only counts while the fuel burns and the cook has begun. The tiers share one block entity, so the upgrade in the world keeps everything inside.
